regions.today: Often cloudy but largely dry today, Saturday, with limited bright or sunny breaks developing and just the odd spot of drizzle or mist possible. Highest temperatures of 18 to 23 degrees, warmest in the south, with moderate west to southwest winds.
regions.tonight: Mainly cloudy but dry for most, with limited clear spells and just the odd spot of drizzle and mist around, as well as some hill fog. Lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees, with light to moderate west to southwest breezes.
regions.tomorrow: Generally cloudy to begin, tomorrow, Sunday, but bright or warm sunny spells will develop in the south of the province. It’ll remain mostly cloudy further north. Highest temperatures of 17 to 23 degrees in light to moderate west to southwest winds.
regions.solar_uv: Moderate under cloud; High in any sunshine.
